title: Chapter 154
text:
Looking through the post, Luzman realized that he had been tagged. He clicked on the post, and the content was the video of the PK between Mad Blade's Angry Sword and Laughing Blade. He gloated and asked him to come out and explain.

Luzman had been criticizing the Mechanic class in all kinds of posts recently. His position was secondary, and his actions were the source of his annoyance. It was as if he was afraid that others would not know what he was thinking. He forced others to watch it, which was very annoying and annoying.

"Luzman, a Mechanic killed an Esper, come out and explain."

After watching the video, Luzman immediately retorted, "This is just an example, that Laughing Blade doesn't know how to play at all!"

"Ha, you keep losing in PK, how did he win? It's purely because you're a noob, okay Luzman? "

Luzman suppressed his anger and replied, "Mad Blade's Angry Sword triggered a hidden storyline. Level suppression, equipment suppression, there's nothing to compare!"

"Is the equipment given by the NPC not considered strength? Then why do you still do missions, take rewards, and earn money? Admit that you're a noob, stand firm! "

F * ck! Luzman was burning with anger and started to curse. "It's none of your business what I say about the Mechanic class!"

"Then why are you still posting everywhere? Can't you think before you speak?"

Luzman was exasperated. "F * ck, what are you barking for? Why do you have to jump out and be scolded by me?"

"You've shown your true colors, haven't you? You're just a troll, what are you pretending for? You chose the class yourself, and you're saying 'I was cheated'? What a joke. Who do you think you are? The game company specifically cheated you? And you still have the face to post everywhere? Are you trying to find a sense of presence? "

"If I wasn't cheated by Black Phantom, would I have chosen the Mechanic class?"

"Oh, it's not my fault, it's the world's fault. No one pointed a gun at your head and forced you to choose a class, right? Pushing the blame to an NPC, are you stupid? If you regret it, just open another account. Don't keep posting nonsense, shut up, kid! "

Luzman was so angry that his head was spinning. "I'm your father, I ¥@% ¥…"

At this time, an official message appeared on Luzman's screen.

Detected that you frequently use insulting words, your forum account will be banned for three days.

Luo Zmen was stunned. "F * ck!"

He couldn't reply. The players in the post soon realized this and gloated.

"Haha, you must have been muted for cursing."

"I'm glad to hear that."

"Go away, go away. He's just a troll."

Luo Zimen could only watch without replying. He was so angry and sullen that he wanted to smash something.

…

"So interesting?"

After reading the replies, Han Xiao felt his hands itch. Unfortunately, he couldn't post anything. Back in the day, he liked to watch and participate in people's catfights on the forum. This was a good way to pass the time.

However, there were also some people who got really angry as they tore at each other. These people were too naive. They couldn't do anything to others when it came to arguing online, but if they couldn't win in theory, they could just start scolding. If they wanted others to admit defeat, they might as well pray for the national football team to make it to the next round. They could just treat this as entertainment. Most of the things on the Internet were fake and couldn't affect their lives. Han Xiao used to be a powerleveler and was also scolded by others. He ate and drank every day. When he had nothing to do, he would say a few words to the people who tore at each other. It was to refresh himself and brighten up the whole day.

Seeing that the players were active on the forum and he could only be a spectator, Han Xiao felt lonely like snow. He missed the days when he had a verbal battle with a group of scholars … although he always felt that the phrase "verbal battle with a group of scholars" was too dirty.

Looking at the time, it was almost dusk. The battlefield had been cleaned up.

Han Xiao heard the sound of engines coming from afar. He looked up and saw a few off-road vehicles driving over from the dirt road. Green Valley Town opened the gate, and Balsas stood by the gate, personally welcoming the vehicles in.

The insignia of the Overmera on the vehicles. Han Xiao thought.

…

The off-road vehicles drove into the town. Armed guards got off and surrounded an exquisitely dressed man.

Xiao Rui, the messenger sent by the second leader of the Overmera, Xiao Jin, came to the Southern Continent to find the Germinal Organization's bounty target, Zero. As early as half a year ago, the Overmera family found that the bounty target, Zero, looked exactly the same as the missing Han Xiao. Thus, Xiao Jin sent people to search for him. However, for a long time, they found nothing. Xiao Rui was the leader of the search team.

Balsas was very respectful to Xiao Rui and led everyone into the main house. The table was decorated with wine and fragrant barbecued meat that was steaming hot. The texture of the meat was like waves, very layered. The reddish-brown meat had a hint of pink tenderness. Even if one did not eat it, one would know that it would be very chewy. This was the gray wolf meat that had been cut two hours ago. The meat was fresh. Other dishes included some vegetables and potato-like mashed crops.

In this kind of town, the cost of this table of dishes was not cheap. Xiao Rui was very satisfied with Balsas' reception.

They sat down, and the travel-worn Xiao Rui ate heartily. He ate three pieces of barbecued meat in a row before slowing down. He wiped his mouth and said slowly to Balsas, who had not eaten yet, "I will rest in your territory for a few days. Then, I will continue to look for that damn bastard."

Balsas said, "I will get someone to prepare a room. Just look for me if you need anything."

Xiao Rui's position in the family was higher than his, so Balsas was very humble.

"Okay." Xiao Rui was satisfied with Balsas' attitude. He decided to stay in Green Valley Town for a few more days. In the past half a year, he had been looking for news about Zero everywhere in the Southern Continent. He had enough of the aimless search. It was a kind of torture.

Ever since Han Xiao disappeared, everyone in the family thought that he was dead and did not care. However, when they found out that he was' Zero ', everyone was shocked. Overmera did not want to provoke the Germinal Organization. In order to find out what happened, Xiao Jin sent him to bring Han Xiao back to the family for questioning. However, he could not find the target even after half a year.

Xiao Rui was full of resentment towards Han Xiao. It was all because of this guy who 'came back from the dead' that he could not stay in the family headquarters and enjoy life.

He had seen Han Xiao a few times before. He was weak and useless. If he was not Xiao Jin's biological son, he would have been sent to clean the toilets. Xiao Rui was an adopted war orphan. Xiao Jin had many such orphans. They grew up together and competed with each other. They worked hard to improve their status, so he was very jealous of Han Xiao's luck of not having to work hard since birth.

When he first found out that Han Xiao had died, he was secretly happy for a long time during the funeral. He knew that the other adopted brothers who lowered their heads and mourned with a sorrowful face also thought the same.

Xiao Rui's preconceived impression made it difficult for him to associate Han Xiao with the Zero that was circulating on the dark net.

Why didn't he just die obediently? Why did he have to cause trouble for me? Xiao Rui complained more than once. He looked at Balsas, chatted for a while, and asked casually, "Has anything happened in the town recently?"

"Yes, the group of refugees outside …" Balsas told him what he found.

Xiao Rui was surprised. "There's such a strange group of people. You have to report the results of your observation to the family."

"I know … There's another thing. Black Phantom is also resting outside the town. The reason is unknown. He said that it was on the way."

Xiao Rui's heart skipped a beat. "Black Phantom is here too?"

Recently, the assassin list on the dark net had been updated. Black Phantom's ranking had risen to seventh. He was very active. Knowing that this legendary assassin was nearby, Xiao Rui was a little uneasy.

"It's best that we don't provoke him," Balsas said.

Xiao Rui did not comment and frowned. He turned around and saw the expressionless bodyguard, Liu Cheng, behind him. His nervousness eased a lot.

Liu Cheng felt Xiao Rui's gaze and said lightly, "Don't worry. Even if it's Black Phantom, I can protect your life. He can't do anything to me."

…

The sun was setting.

Ever since the off-road vehicle entered the town, Han Xiao was acutely aware of the changes in Green Valley Town. The lookouts in the town were constantly monitoring him, as if they were worried about his activities. From this small detail, Han Xiao was 80% sure that there was an important person in the convoy that had just entered the town.

The Overmera family. I don't have a deep impression of them. They didn't seem to have any special performance in the original storyline … Oh, I remember now. I think this family was one of the main forces in a side storyline of 'Rogue Warlords Struggle for Hegemony'. Yes, this side storyline has some conflicts with Bennett's sanctuary main storyline. I don't have much contact with rogues, so it shouldn't affect this side storyline.
